name: agentinbox
description: All your selected Gmail and Microsoft mail and calendars in one local plugin, without switching accounts.

interface.shortDescription: All your Gmail and Microsoft mail in one plugin. No account switching.
interface.longDescription: Search your selected Gmail and Microsoft accounts in one AgentInbox plugin, without switching accounts. Read the messages or appointments you request. You choose accounts and sharing in the local AgentInbox app. Requested content can reach the assistant's AI service.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentInbox to find my unread mail from today across all my accounts.
Use AgentInbox to show today's appointments across all my calendars.
